scenario: 今日检索这一侧，既有人把文本、图像、页面和视频收进同一套可服务的多向量索引，也有人让相关性和长上下文把有限计算用在更值钱的证据上。有的模型压缩之后几乎不掉点，还能把命中定位到页面或视频片段。有的相关性模型把推理蒸馏成分类头，服务时不再自回归。视频检索开始在认时间的同时保住通用检索，智能体搜索则用更快的估计减少重排次数。长视频按 token 的边际价值分配预算，长表格则先决定是先算统计量还是先取行。图库换编码器时，新旧向量可以在同一次回填里一起被查询。生成式搜索的答案名单并不稳定，可见度要分别报告谁出现、谁排第一。检索引擎也可以直接查还在对象存储里的文件。

papers.title: OmniEVIE: Evidence-Vector-Informed Embedding for Multi-modal Retrieval
papers.authors: Zifei Wang, Wei Wen, Qiang Ji, Qian-Wen Zhang, Ruizhi Qiao, He Liu, Xing Sun, Qiang Lin
papers.abstract: Multimodal retrieval must match dense pages, fine-grained entities, ordered video, and agent tools and memory. Single-vector embeddings lose local evidence, cross-encoders reread every recalled item online, and uncompressed late interaction is too large to serve. We present OmniEVIE, a 4.5B multi-vector embedding model covering text, images, visual documents, video, and tools with one compressed index and a three-stage retriever. Each record stores at most 128 int8 vectors of dimension 64 (9,472 bytes, or 8.82 GiB per million records), providing a mean vector, 1-bit signs, and int8 multi-vectors for coarse, middle, and final search while localizing each hit to a page region or video interval. Training, merging, indexing, and retrieval are co-designed: all tasks share one retrieval format, a three-grade evidence check removes false negatives, dynamic sampling follows the baseline-teacher gap, candidates are compressed with ST-HAC during training to match the index, stage-wise and specialist models are merged by parameter block, and a saliency gate with a noise floor refines query scoring. Trained on public datasets, OmniEVIE scores 60.68 (full d=2048 sequence) and 60.06 (K128 x d64 int8 index) on MMEB-V3 (190 tasks), 77.96 on MMEB-V2 (78 tasks), and 62.96 on ViDoRe V3 (48 tasks). On 1M and 5M records, a single-thread query takes 54.2 ms and 120.2 ms (11.1x and 25.3x faster than exact 4096-d single-vector search; 236x and 532x faster than full int8 MaxSim). Video is encoded directly from frames without a parsing model: on QVHighlights (1,083 queries), the peak falls inside the labeled segment for 78.0% of queries and the returned span (18% of video length) intersects it for 94.3% vs. 44.9% random. Weights and code: https://huggingface.co/tencent/OmniEVIE-4B and https://github.com/Tencent/OmniEVIE.
papers.summary: 多模态检索既要对付密集页面、细粒度实体，也要对付有顺序的视频和智能体工具。单向量会丢掉局部证据，cross-encoder 又要在线重读每个召回结果，未压缩的迟交互则大到难以服务。OmniEVIE 用约四十五亿参数的多向量模型，覆盖文本、图像、视觉文档、视频和工具，却共用一套压缩索引和三阶段检索。每条记录最多存放一百二十八个六十四维的 int8 向量，一百万条大约只占 8.82 GiB，并能为命中定位到页面区域或视频片段。在 MMEB-V3 的一百九十项任务上，完整序列得分 60.68，压缩索引仍有 60.06，几乎没有掉点。百万条语料上，单线程查询只要 54.2 毫秒。视频直接由帧编码，不必再经过解析模型。

papers.title: LARF: Learning-aligned Reasoning Framework for Search Relevance
papers.authors: Tian Tang, Guo Chen, Reed Li, Hao Wang, Yu Lu, Haijin Liang, Haibo Shi
papers.abstract: Query-document relevance estimation is a core component of AI-native search systems, where a model must assess whether retrieved documents satisfy users' information needs under complex, multi-dimensional criteria. However, directly applying large language models (LLMs) to this task remains challenging because conventional supervised fine-tuning (SFT) provides limited supervision for domain-specific judgment rationales, while standard trajectory-level reinforcement learning (RL) objectives do not explicitly enforce margin separation among adjacent ordinal relevance labels. Moreover, although such reasoning can be useful during training, chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is impractical for latency-sensitive online ranking. These challenges make it difficult to resolve ambiguous decision boundaries. We propose a three-stage framework LARF (Learning-Aligned Reasoning Framework for Search Relevance): it first performs cold-start SFT on strategically selected samples with multi-agent guided CoT rationales, then applies discriminative GRPO with attribute-wise, list-wise, and rule-consistency rewards together with a margin loss on the terminal relevance token, and finally distills the teacher into a dual-head student whose classification heads are retained for non-autoregressive inference. On a human-annotated web search relevance benchmark with approximately 300K training and 16K test instances, LARF-8B improves six-class classification accuracy by 5.78 percentage points and NDCG by 5.05 points, while the classification-only serving path reduces inference latency by 82.9\%. These results indicate that aligning structured reasoning, terminal decision optimization, and classification-head distillation can provide an effective accuracy--efficiency trade-off for industrial search relevance modeling.
papers.summary: AI 搜索要判断文档是否满足复杂、多维度的信息需求，直接用大模型做这件事并不容易。普通微调给不出领域里特有的判断理由，轨迹级强化学习又不一定能拉开相邻相关性等级之间的间隔，推理时再走思维链也往往太慢。LARF 先在多智能体引导的思维链样本上做冷启动微调，再用带间隔损失的判别式强化学习对准最终相关性标记，最后把教师蒸馏成只保留分类头的学生，推理时不必自回归生成。在约三十万条训练、一万六千条测试的人工标注网页相关性基准上，LARF-8B 的六类分类准确率提高 5.78 个百分点，NDCG 提高 5.05 个点。只走分类头的服务路径把推理延迟降低了 82.9%。

papers.title: Teaching Time Without Losing General Retrieval: Adapting Multimodal Embeddings for Time-Sensitive Video Retrieval
papers.authors: Rainer Lienhart, Shin' Toya Oyama, ichi Satoh
papers.abstract: In text-to-video retrieval, MLLM-based embedding models do well when the text describes the scene (general retrieval), but poorly when it describes actions and their direction (time-sensitive retrieval). TARA, a pioneering work, fine-tunes such a model on text triplets with temporal hard negatives; it improves time-sensitive retrieval but lowers general retrieval (mean R@1 over six benchmarks in our rerun on Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B: 58.4->44.8), and its released model keeps general retrieval only when ensembled with Qwen3-VL-Embedding. Our goal is strong general and time-sensitive retrieval with one model and one vector per clip. Three findings lead to three simple components. Keep loss: general retrieval follows how far the output embeddings drift from the base model, not how far the weights move; we therefore keep them near the base model, which keeps most general retrieval even without general-domain data. Pair loss: the text embeddings of an action description and its reversed-direction version are well separated, but the video embeddings of a clip and its reversed copy are close; we therefore widen the gap between the video embeddings of each clip and its reversed copy, in the direction of the difference between their two text embeddings. Middle-layer LoRA: frames are combined in the middle layers, and temporal information peaks in or just after them; we therefore train LoRA only on these layers, which nearly matches training all weights on most time-sensitive benchmarks with 0.15% of the parameters and keeps general retrieval better. General R@1 stays at 58.4, while R@1 with each clip's reversed copy in the gallery rises from 55.5 to 63.2; the gains carry over to unseen benchmarks and InternVL2-8B-RA. The keep loss is also a remedy for the TARA recipe (general R@1: 44.8->57.8), and ensembling TARA with Ours gives the highest scores on RTime and unseen CiA among the compared models.
papers.summary: 文本搜视频时，多模态 embedding 模型擅长匹配场景描述，却不擅长匹配动作及其方向。已有做法用时间困难负例微调，能提高对时间敏感的检索，却会把通用检索打下去。新方法坚持用一个模型和每个片段一个向量，同时保住两方面。它发现片段和其倒放在视频 embedding 里往往靠得太近，于是沿两条文本 embedding 的差值方向把这条间隔拉开，并把 LoRA 只加在时间信息最集中的中间层。通用检索的 R@1 仍保持 58.4，把倒放拷贝放进候选库后，R@1 从 55.5 升到 63.2。这些 LoRA 参数只占全部权重的 0.15%，在多数时间敏感基准上已接近训练全部权重，也能用到未见过的基准和其他模型上。

papers.title: SOARS: System One Assisted Reranking for Agentic Search
papers.authors: Amin Bigdeli, Liye Fu, Fattane Zarrinkalam, Joel Stremmel, Elizabeth Lingg
papers.abstract: Deep search agents address complex information needs through iterative retrieval and reasoning, where the relevance of retrieved evidence influences downstream performance. Existing rerankers improve retrieval effectiveness but introduce substantial latency and cost when invoked throughout the search trajectory. We introduce SOARS, a training-free framework leveraging a System One model for fast, calibrated relevance estimation. At each search step, SOARS selects query-relevant passages from long documents and reranks candidates in a single call, jointly considering the original question and agent-generated sub-query. Across six LLM backbones on BrowseComp-Plus and WebShaper, SOARS consistently improves answer accuracy and evidence recall while reducing search calls, end-to-end latency, and inference cost. On BrowseComp-Plus, it improves GPT-5.4 Mini's accuracy from 73.9% to 84.7% while reducing search calls from 23 to 14, demonstrating the potential of System One reranking for more effective and efficient deep search.
papers.summary: 深度搜索智能体要反复检索和推理，证据是否相关会直接影响后面的答案，可全程调用重排器又会带来明显的延迟和费用。SOARS 不必额外训练，用一个反应更快的 System One 模型做校准过的相关性估计。每一步只调用一次，就能从长文档里抽出与问题有关的段落，并同时参考原始问题和智能体生成的子查询来重排候选。在 BrowseComp-Plus 和 WebShaper 上，它对六种大模型骨干都能提高答题准确率和证据召回，同时减少搜索次数、端到端延迟和推理费用。在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，GPT-5.4 Mini 的准确率从 73.9% 提高到 84.7%。搜索次数从 23 次降到 14 次。也就是说，深度搜索不必每一步都请昂贵的重排器，用校准过的快速估计就能把检索次数和费用压下去。

papers.title: Efficient Video Retrieval Augmented Generation via Token Allocation
papers.authors: Ayush Barik, Fan Lai, Francis Y. Yan
papers.abstract: Efficient long-video understanding requires identifying relevant evidence while minimizing the tokens processed by vision-language models (VLMs). Existing video retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods rely on frame selection and token compression, but overlook how much each additional token is worth. We introduce Lembas, a plug-and-play framework that formulates video RAG as a token allocation problem over frames and subtitles under a shared budget. Our key insight is that the value of a token diminishes within each item and decreases further as similar evidence receives more tokens. Lembas captures both effects in a single objective and solves it with an efficient iterative water-filling algorithm that has a provable convergence guarantee. For multi-turn conversations, Lembas reuses the tokens processed in earlier turns and refines relevance with the VLM's attention at no extra cost. Our evaluations show that Lembas improves accuracy by up to 7.2 percentage points over state-of-the-art baselines at comparable compute. On multi-turn video understanding, Lembas achieves up to 1.5 percentage points higher accuracy with 1.7-17.3x fewer TFLOPs.
papers.summary: 要理解长视频，就得找出相关证据，又不能让视觉语言模型处理过多 token。现有的视频检索增强生成多半只做选帧和压缩，却很少问多给一个 token 到底还值不值。Lembas 把这件事看成在共享预算下，给帧和字幕分配 token 的问题。它的关键观察是，同一条证据里，后来的 token 越来越不值钱，相似证据再拿到更多 token，价值还会继续下降。它把这两种衰减写进同一个目标，并用有收敛保证的迭代注水算法来求解。多轮对话里，还可以复用前面已经处理过的 token，并用模型注意力重新估计相关性，不必再额外计算。精度最多比现有最强基线高 7.2 个百分点。在多轮视频理解上，精度最多再高 1.5 个百分点，所用浮点运算可减少 1.7 到 17.3 倍。

papers.title: TableRouter: Query-Aware Evidence Construction for Long-Table Question Answering
papers.authors: Anahita Bolourani, Xiaofeng Lin, Tung Sum Thomas Kwok, Guang Cheng
papers.abstract: LLMs can reason over tables, but when tables outgrow the context budget, retrieving relevant rows is only part of the solution. A retrieved subset may omit information required for an exact aggregate; even complete evidence may remain difficult for an LLM to use. We introduce TableRouter, a training-free framework that analyzes each query, then chooses between two routes: a computation route, which derives question-conditioned statistics from the full table, and a coverage route, which retrieves relevant rows and column summaries. The chosen context is passed to a frozen LLM in one call. Across three LLMs and three large-table benchmarks, TableRouter outperforms the strongest of six single-call baselines in all nine settings by 1.2-18.3 accuracy points, using 77-95% fewer estimated FLOPs than truncated-table prompting, with indexing amortized across questions. The gains extend to long tables from databases not used in earlier experiments, where TableRouter achieves 35.8% with Qwen2.5-7B, versus 16.4% for the strongest external baseline. A controlled experiment shows that explicitly providing computed statistics improves accuracy by up to 40.0 points, even when all answer-determining rows are available. These results distinguish evidence access from evidence use: long-table reasoning depends on how information is represented, not only on which rows are retrieved.
papers.summary: 大模型能对表格做推理，可表一长过上下文预算，只把相关行检索回来往往还不够。检索子集可能漏掉精确汇总所需的信息，即便证据齐全，模型也不一定用得好。TableRouter 不必额外训练，先分析问题再选路：一条路从全表算出与问题相关的统计量，另一条路检索相关行和列摘要，选好的上下文只调用一次冻结的大模型。在三个模型和三个长表基准的全部九组设定里，它都超过六种单次调用基线里最强的那一个。把算好的统计量明确提供给模型，准确率最多可再提高 40.0 个百分点，即便所有决定答案的行都已经在上下文里。在先前实验没用过的数据库长表上，配合 Qwen2.5-7B 的准确率达到 35.8%，最强外部基线只有 16.4%。

papers.title: RELAY: Learning Compatible Representations One Encoder at a Time
papers.authors: Yu Wang, Chuan Qin, Qiang Zhang
papers.abstract: Old and new document embeddings coexist during incremental gallery re-encoding. RELAY trains a new query encoder with a learned projection against the original gallery, then freezes both to train the new document encoder. The same query vector scores both document versions throughout a single re-encoding pass. After backfill, optional query refinement drops the projection and reuses the stored document vectors. Across three text-to-image retrieval upgrades on COCO and Flickr30K, RELAY improves Recall@1 on untouched galleries by 8.66-10.23 percentage points over the original systems. For direct re-encoding, RELAY ranks first in both Qwen-to-Qwen upgrades and second in CLIP-to-Qwen by area under the Recall@1 curve, under both native scoring and matched calibration. With embeddings held fixed, calibrating scores separately for each document version can reduce drops in Recall@1 during backfill and change which method achieves the highest backfill AUC. After query refinement, final Recall@1 is within 0.97 percentage points of conventional joint training in all three upgrades.
papers.summary: 图库要换新的文档编码器时，新旧嵌入会在回填过程中并存，查询向量往往不能同时对两种文档版本公平打分。RELAY 先让新的查询编码器带着一个学出来的投影，对着原来的图库训练，再把两者冻结，去训练新的文档编码器。同一次回填里，同一个查询向量就能给两个版本的文档打分。回填结束后，还可以做可选的查询精炼，丢掉投影并复用已经存好的文档向量。在 COCO 和 Flickr30K 的三次文搜图升级中，它对尚未更新的图库，把 Recall@1 提高了 8.66 到 10.23 个百分点。精炼之后，最终 Recall@1 与常规联合训练的差距不超过 0.97 个百分点。这说明升级编码器不必等整库重算完才能用。

papers.title: Ask Again: Answer-List Instability in Generative Engines
papers.authors: Björn Busch-Geertsema, David Antony Selby, Sebastian Vollmer
papers.abstract:
Visibility in generative search engines is measured by which entities appear in responses, and in what order. Ask an engine the same question twice and the answer list can change: a different ordering, or different items altogether. Across 60,000 responses, we find that answers to the same prompt name a different first item 32% of the time, and even two answers with the same items disagree on which comes first. The first position is a measurement target of its own.
A "clear leader" emerges after seven or eight runs, which are the budgets recommended for brand and source monitoring, but a "close leader" only about half the time. After 25 runs, a close leader is identified only 60% of the time. Variability between engines is larger than within the same engine. For open-ended prompts, the gap is more than double that for determinate ones. Search queries and cited sites observed leave most of the disagreement unexplained.
Visibility measurement should report, for each engine, which items appear and how often each comes first, each with its own quantification of uncertainty.
papers.summary: 生成式搜索引擎的可见度，取决于回答里出现了哪些实体、又以什么顺序出现。同一句问再问一遍，名单却可能换序，甚至换成另一批条目。在 60,000 次回答里，同一提示有 32% 的时候会点出不同的第一条，即便两次列出的条目相同，何者居首也可能不一致。第一条本身就是一个独立的测量目标。七八次重复之后，往往能看出一个明显领先者，可这正是品牌和来源监测常用的预算；真正接近的领先者，大约只有一半时候能确定。即便问到 25 次，接近的领先者也只有 60% 的时候能被认定。引擎与引擎之间的差异，比同一引擎内部更大。可见度报告应当分别写出哪些条目出现过、各自多久排第一，并带上不确定性。

papers.title: Data Auctions for Retrieval Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Minbiao Han, Seyed A. Esmaeili, Michael Albert, Haifeng Xu
papers.abstract: We study the problem of data selling for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) tasks in Generative AI applications. We model each buyer's valuation of a dataset with a natural coverage-based valuation function that increases with the inclusion of more relevant data points that would enhance responses to anticipated queries. Motivated by exclusive licensing for RAG, we focus on the scenario where each data point can be allocated to only one buyer. We show that the problem of welfare maximization in this setting is NP-hard even with two bidders, but  design a polynomial-time $(1-1/e)$ approximation algorithm for any number of bidders. Unfortunately, however, this efficient allocation algorithm fails to be incentive compatible. The crux of our approach is   a carefully tailored  post-processing step called \emph{data burning} which retains the $(1-1/e)$ approximation factor but achieves incentive compatibility. Our thorough experiments on synthetic and real-world image and text datasets  demonstrate the practical effectiveness of our algorithm compared to popular baseline algorithms for combinatorial auctions.
papers.summary: 检索增强生成要向买家出售数据时，一份数据对买方的价值会随着能覆盖更多预期查询的相关样本而上升。若每条样本只能独家卖给一个买家，福利最大化即使只有两个竞拍者也已经是 NP-hard。作者给出一种多项式时间算法，能在任意多个竞拍者时达到 (1-1/e) 的近似比，可这个高效分配本身并不能保证激励相容。关键补丁是事后烧掉一部分数据：在保住同一近似比的同时，让机制变成激励相容。它还可以借助虚拟估值，把同一近似保证转到收益最大化。在合成数据以及真实的图像和文本数据集上，这套做法也比常见的组合拍卖基线更管用。

papers.title: No pipeline, no second copy: Querying Amazon S3 from Elasticsearch with ES|QL
papers.abstract: With ES|QL Data Federation, an S3 bucket is a data source you query with the same FROM syntax you use for an index, and federated identity keeps AWS credentials out of Elasticsearch.
papers.summary: 要把已经躺在对象存储里的历史日志或表格拿来检索，传统做法往往先做数据管道，再在集群里存一份副本，既贵也慢。Elasticsearch 的 ES|QL Data Federation 可以把 Amazon S3 桶登记成数据源，用和查索引相同的 FROM 句法直接查询其中的 Parquet、CSV、TSV 和 NDJSON 文件，而不必把数据拷进集群。模式来自文件本身，因而也不必先建摄取管道或映射。过滤和列选择会下推到 Parquet 读取器，查询只从 S3 读取需要的列。联合身份认证让 AWS 凭证不必写进 Elasticsearch。热索引和已经放在对象存储里的冷数据可以在同一次查询里一起扫。该功能目前仍是技术预览，适合先做探索，而不是把所有生产检索都搬过去。
